extracted.intended_audience: consumers, industry, media, and stakeholders tracking FDA-regulated product recalls
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and the data fields used by the FDA to publish and archive Recalls, Market Withdrawals, and Safety Alerts gathered from press releases and public notices; intended to support searching, subscription, and export of recall information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The calendar date the recall/notice was posted (used to sort and filter entries; shown in the table and used for 'Content current as of' metadata).

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand Name(s)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The commercial brand name(s) under which the recalled product is marketed. Useful for public identification and search; may include multiple brands if applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product Description
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A short textual description of the product (e.g., 'Sunflower Seeds', 'Banana Nut Muffins'). Should succinctly identify the item being recalled to aid consumer recognition and search.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product Type
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Categorization of the product into regulatory/sector types (examples shown: 'Food & Beverages, Allergens', 'Animal & Veterinary, Pet Food'). Use standardized category labels to enable filtering and grouping of recalls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recall Reason Description
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A brief description of why the recall was issued (e.g., 'Undeclared Cashews', 'Potential Salmonella Contamination', 'Potential to be contaminated with Clostridium botulinum'). This should capture the hazard, contaminant, allergen, or other safety concern driving the recall.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company Name
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The name of the company responsible for the product/recall (e.g., 'George J. Howe Co.', 'Legacy Snack Solutions'). Important for accountability, searches, and cross-referencing with company notices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terminated Recall
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator or field that denotes whether a recall has been terminated/resolved. Use this to show lifecycle status of the recall (active vs. terminated).

rubrics_metrics.name: Excerpt
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A short excerpt from the underlying press release or public notice summarizing the recall. Should provide a quick read of the key facts; link to full press release where available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source of information
rubrics_metrics.description: The list below provides information gathered from press releases and other public notices about certain recalls of FDA-regulated products.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries are compiled from official press releases and public notices. Note that the dataset is not a comprehensive feed of all enforcement actions — it reflects notices that have press releases or were otherwise posted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion caveat / completeness
rubrics_metrics.description: Not all recalls have press releases or are posted on this page. See Additional information about recalls for a more complete listing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not assume the page is exhaustive. For comprehensive research, consult the linked 'Additional information about recalls' and other FDA resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archiving policy / retention
rubrics_metrics.description: The Recalls, Market Withdrawals & Safety Alerts are available on FDA’s website for three years before being archived.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content is retained on this page for three years; older items are moved to archives. When citing or searching, be aware of the three-year active window and use archives for older items.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to search archived content
rubrics_metrics.description: To search archived content, visit Search FDA Archive and input the name of the product and/or company name in the Search terms box as well as the year to get the most inclusive search results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search archived recalls by combining product/company name with the year to maximize recall discovery. Use the FDA Archive search rather than relying solely on the active listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year-based archive browsing
rubrics_metrics.description: To scroll through archived Recalls, Market Withdrawals & Safety Alerts content by year, see the Recall and Safety Alerts Archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An archive index organized by year is available for manual browsing if search queries are insufficient or to review recalls chronologically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription / notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign up to receive Recalls, Market Withdrawals and Safety Alerts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can subscribe to receive updates. Implement a subscription mechanism for timely distribution of new recall press releases and alerts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal staff note
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA Employees: Use Chrome to Subscribe until further notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational note for internal users about browser-specific subscription behavior; include internal-facing guidance where necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data export availability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide machine-readable export (XLSX) of the recall listing to support bulk analysis, reporting, or ingestion by external systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content currency / last updated
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display the 'content current as of' date (e.g., '05/08/2026') so users know the freshness of the listing and when to check archives or other sources for newer updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-level navigation / related resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Recall Resources; Enforcement Reports; Industry Guidance For Recalls; Major Product Recalls
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Link to related resource pages (guidance, enforcement reports, major recalls) to provide context, deeper guidance, and background for both producers and consumers of recall press releases.
